title: A Spider Lives at 22,000 Feet on Everest. What Does It Eat?

scenes.text: A tiny spider lives at twenty-two thousand feet on Mount Everest.
It's the Himalayan jumping spider, and it's the highest-living spider ever found.
Up there it's ice, rock and thin air.
It's believed to eat tiny insects that the wind blows up from far below.
It was first found in 1924, at about sixty-seven hundred meters.
The scientists who named it called it Euophrys omnisuperstes. It means highest of all.

description:
A tiny jumping spider lives at about 22,000 feet on Mount Everest.
The Himalayan jumping spider hides in rock cracks and is believed to eat tiny insects blown up from lower down. It is the highest-living spider ever recorded.
Would you climb that high?
first_comment: Its Latin name means highest of all. What would you name it?
